It features a long central corridor with high arched ceilings and skylights. On both sides, there are two levels of cell blocks with iron railings and barred doors. Several people (tourists/visitors) are walking through the corridor in the foreground and mid-ground. The architecture is utilitarian, constructed of brick and stone/concrete.
